symptom: The durable Human Task model allowed multiple differently identified responses for the same four-part task correlation, while recovery selected the latest response.
root_cause: human_task_responses had only response_id uniqueness; no persistence invariant guaranteed a single authoritative response per Objective ID + Execution ID + Human Task ID + Correlation ID.
early_signals: load_human_task_bundle orders responses by received_time DESC and takes LIMIT 1
human_task_responses allowed different response_id values for the same correlated Human Task
SCN-030 validated wrong-execution rejection but not same-task replay/conflict
human_cost: No human intervention required to detect or remediate in the feature branch; the defect could otherwise create ambiguous or silently replaced human authority.
prevention_rule: A durable Human Task accepts one authoritative response. A changed decision must create a new task or explicit decision event rather than a later conflicting response.
automated_detection: SCN-031 PostgreSQL replay/conflict regression test plus unique persistence index.
